annotation.title_clean: Mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund: application EGF/2024/002 BE/Limburg machinery and paper - Belgium
annotation.title_en: Mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund: application EGF/2024/002 BE/Limburg machinery and paper - Belgium
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution of 17 December 2024 approving mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Belgium, giving EUR 704,135 to support 632 workers made redundant at Sappi Lanaken (paper) and Purmo Group (machinery) in Limburg. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves an EGF contribution of EUR 704,135 (60% of EUR 1,173,559) to Belgium
Targets 632 workers made redundant at Sappi Lanaken and Purmo Group Belgium
Finances personalised services: guidance, job-search support, retraining and digital skills
EGF aid must not replace employers' legal obligations and must respect non-discrimination
Calls for proactive measures to adapt industries to technological and environmental change
